text:
mira: Heads up — CI alert: integration/hosted-api-e2e (shard 9) is red. Failing tests touch auth handshake + streaming tool-calls. Logs show `422` on tool-caller and an auth header parse error.

jess: can you paste the failing test names / short log snippet?

mira: failing tests: `HostedToolSmoke.test_stream_toolcall_with_auth`, `AuthHandshake.test_jwks_rotation`. Snippet: 
```
ERROR: tool-caller response 422 {
  "error": "invalid tool payload"
}
Sep 14 11:03:21 runtime: auth: failed to parse kid header: unknown key id
```

samir: hmm, last infra change touched the runtime's `Accept`/`Content-Type` handling for chunked tool uploads. Could be parsing strictness. Any recent model/runtime canary?

mira: @samir yes, rolled canary `runtime-v2.9.1` earlier today (PR #4823). It tightened multipart parsing under `--enable-tool-schema-strict`.

andrew: if it's the strict flag, quick mitigation: flip `INTEGRATION_TOOL_STRICT=false` for the hosted smoke pipeline, rerun just shard 9 to confirm. If that fixes, we can bisect the runtime change.

jess: I can kick a targeted rerun. ci-bot, please rerun job integration/hosted-api-e2e --shard=9 with env `INTEGRATION_TOOL_STRICT=false`.

ci-bot: Rerun queued: https://ci.internal/runs/82345 (shard=9) — triggered by jess.

samir: also, small repro to try locally against staging:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" \
  -F 'payload=@-;type=application/json' \
  https://staging-hosted.example.com/toolcall/execute \
  <<'EOF'\n{"action":"call","tool":"math"}\nEOF
```
If the runtime rejects with 415/422, that's the same class of failure.

mira: rerun finished: still red. Looks like `AuthHandshake.test_jwks_rotation` fails intermittently post-rerun, toolcall consistent 422.

jess: OK going to bisect the runtime commits between `v2.9.0` and `v2.9.1`. Will run targeted smoke suites in parallel. ETA ~25m.

andrew: when you bisect, please include a run that forces older JWKS caching behavior (env `JWKS_CACHE_TTL=60s`) — that isolates the kid rotation angle.

jess: bisect progress: narrowed to commit `abc1234` — change is parser branch: tighten boundary handling for chunked multipart when `Content-Type` includes `boundary=`.

samir: that lines up. The change added a strict header sanity check that can throw on some proxies that reformat multipart headers.

mira: for now let's: 1) revert the strict parse in canary, 2) patch parser to tolerate header whitespace/linewraps, 3) add a smoke test that sends chunked multipart through our auth proxy.

jess: reverting canary and pushing a temporary guard now. Will report back when CI stabilizes.

ci-bot: New run queued: https://ci.internal/runs/82349 (shard=9) — triggered by jess.

mira: nice, thanks. If green I'll open the rollback PR and we can do a proper fix in `runtime` with tests.

andrew: also add a small fuzz case for `Content-Type` header variations. Prevent future regresses.

jess: will do. cc @samir on runtime PR.

mira: thanks team — keeping this thread as the coordination hub. :thumbsup:
